title: Emoji Chat
description: Type emojis in Minecraft chat using simple tags like :heart: ❤ :smile: 😊 and more - visible by everyone!
body:
💬 Emoji Chat — Type emojis in Minecraft chat!

Emoji Chat is a lightweight client-side Fabric mod that lets you type emojis in Minecraft chat using simple tags like :heart: ❤ or :smile: 😊 — no texture packs required, visible to everyone on the server.

✨ Features

* 🔄 Tag-to-Emoji Conversion — Type :heart: and it automatically converts to ❤ when you send
* 🎯 Autocomplete — Start typing : and get suggestions for all available emojis
* 👥 Server Compatible — Everyone sees the emojis even without the mod installed
* 🪶 Lightweight — Client-side only, zero performance impact
* 🎮 Minecraft-themed emojis — Includes ⛏ :pickaxe:, ⚔ :sword:and more!

📋 How to use
Type any emoji tag in chat (e.g. :heart:) and it will be converted to the emoji when sent. You can also start typing : to see autocomplete suggestions.

- If you have found any bugs please report them, you can do that in the [Discord](https://discord.gg/DjCa9zBAUt) server linked to the right
Thanks
